review:
Throne of Elements: Platinum is an elemental-themed Hold the Jackpot game on a 25-reel grid, built around reels that unlock as you play. Guardian symbols appear on the middle row, stay sticky and activate additional reels, so the playing area grows during a session.

Cash Infinity symbols lock in place until the end of the bonus and keep adding to the final total. A Cash Out timer turns Mystery Cash symbols into instant payouts when its countdown hits zero, and Chance Level lets you multiply the stake by up to 10x to trigger the bonus more often. The Grand Jackpot is 2,500x the bet. Wazdan lists a 96.15% RTP and high volatility. It suits players who like progression systems more than classic line wins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
